speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Whom. Susanna's hand, and nothing else on the slip.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I did not say which of them tied it. The tale was in my mouth, ready, and I kept it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two pairs of hose. A cake of my mother's. Useful, and more welcome than the performance.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A month ago I promised. The promise held. Enough.
